entities.name: Extended protocol configuration options
entities.description: This IE is included when the UE wishes to transmit protocol data (e.g., configuration parameters, error codes, or messages/events) to the network. It is supported end-to-end for the PDN connection.

entities.name: User Equipment
entities.description: The UE includes the extended protocol configuration options IE to transmit protocol data to the network.

entities.name: Network
entities.description: The network receives the extended protocol configuration options IE from the UE when supported end-to-end for the PDN connection.

entities.name: Extended protocol configuration options supported end-to-end
entities.description: The extended protocol configuration options IE is included only when supported by both the UE and the network end-to-end for the PDN connection.

relations.description: The UE includes the extended protocol configuration options IE to transmit protocol data to the network.
Inclusion of the extended protocol configuration options IE is conditional on it being supported by both the UE and the network end-to-end for the PDN connection.
